# Bayan Brew — synthetic data dictionary

**Purpose:** Portfolio dataset for this report. **Fictional brand.** Not real company data.

**Generated by:** `generate_transactions.py` (seed `20261001`) for reproducibility.

**Coverage:** 2025-01-01 through 2025-09-30, Philippines-oriented store names and PHP pricing.

## Files

| File | Grain | Rows (approx.) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bayan-brew-transactions.csv` | One row per order line item | 37,406 lines |
| `bayan-brew-stores.csv` | One row per store | 10 |
| `bayan-brew-products.csv` | One row per SKU / menu item | 15 |

## Join keys

- `bayan-brew-transactions.StoreID` → `bayan-brew-stores.StoreID`
- `bayan-brew-transactions.ProductID` → `bayan-brew-products.ProductID`

## Column definitions

### Transactions

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OrderID | text | Unique order identifier (multiple lines per order) |
| OrderDate | date | Order date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| OrderTime | text | Local time HH:MM (24h) |
| StoreID | text | FK to stores |
| ProductID | text | FK to products |
| Size | text | Small / Medium / Large; Add-ons use `N/A` |
| Quantity | whole number | Units on this line |
| UnitPricePHP | decimal | Price per unit in Philippine pesos |
| LineRevenuePHP | decimal | Quantity × UnitPricePHP |

### Stores

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| StoreID | Primary key |
| StoreName | Mall / location label |
| City | City |
| Region | Philippine region group (simplified) |

### Products

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ProductID | Primary key |
| ProductName | Menu label |
| Category | Milk Tea, Signature, etc. |
| BasePriceSmall | Reference price for Small (before size multiplier in generator) |

## Modeling notes (for Power BI)

- **Fact:** transactions (numeric: Quantity, UnitPricePHP, LineRevenuePHP).
- **Dimensions:** stores, products; build a **Date** table from `OrderDate`.
- **Revenue measure:** prefer `SUM(LineRevenuePHP)` not UnitPrice × Quantity unless you validate duplicates.

## Assumptions (for interviews)

- Weekend days ~35% higher order volume than weekdays.
- Apr, May, Dec slightly elevated (“school break / holidays”).
- MOA and BGC stores weighted higher traffic.
- Size mix: mostly Medium; prices scale by size tier.
